adjudication.rationale: In `rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` now does `type.replace('_', '-')` before checking membership in `ADMIN_MODELS`. JS `String#replace` without a global regex only replaces the first underscore, so a hypothetical admin model type like `foo_bar_baz` would become `foo-bar_baz` and fail to match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry like `foo-bar-baz`, causing it to fall back to `"/"` instead of `"/admin/"`. However, in this diff all listed admin models (`plugin`, `site-customization`, `embeddable-host`) and the known store type forms they’re intended to bridge (e.g. `embeddable_host`, `site_customization`) have at most one underscore, so this is a robustness/maintainability concern rather than a currently verifiable defect.
